name: Phalanx Captain: reserve cost reduced by 1 per HUMAN ally (Class Bonus)
notes: Phalanx Captain is WIND element with a self-referential activationCostModifierAbilities entry (rPpLwLPGaL:0) that reduces its own reserve cost by 1 per HUMAN ally controlled, gated on WARRIOR Class Bonus. Champion CardID-patched to Lorraine, Blademaster (WARRIOR) with Spirit of Wind added via Subcards for WIND access; Dungeon Guide (a HUMAN ally) is seeded onto the field. With 1 HUMAN ally, the printed 5 reserve cost is reduced to 4 (paid with exactly 4 reserve actions, confirmed by decision_queue_empty after exactly 4 'myHand-0' payments plus p1Field-2.CardID=rPpLwLPGaL proving the card actually entered play). An earlier draft opened with the two-pass 'P1 myHealth-0 Pass, P2 myHealth-0 Pass' idiom used elsewhere in this deck to reach a later turn's material phase -- but this champion's own BEOP fast action (from the WARRIOR/WIND lineage) makes P1's single decline of it end P1's entire turn 1 outright, handing priority to P2 before the card was ever played, so the subsequent myHand-7!FSM! play and all 4 reserve payments silently no-op'd against an empty decision queue (ActionMap's myHand case requires playerID===turnPlayer and just breaks otherwise, no WARN) -- Phalanx Captain never left hand and the discount was never actually exercised, despite the fixture reporting success with only a trivial TurnEffects/zone_count assertion to (not) catch it. Fixed by dropping the two-pass opener: the initial gamestate already starts in P1's own turn-1 MAIN phase.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] This card costs 1 less to activate for each HUMAN ally you control.
